newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks at new unofficial record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks at new unofficial record close.

text.p: The Mexican bourse trimmed some earlier sharp gains, but held steady and posted an unofficial closing record on Wednesday.
Analysts and traders said the Federal Open Market Committee decision not to change rates did not boost share prices, as it had been discounted, but did keep the market firm as it removed uncertainty.
Preliminary figures showed the leading IPC share index was up 51.60 points when the closing bell rang, or 1.14 percent, at an historic level of 4,560.39.
